scope: Madagascar medical discovery — Université d'Antananarivo Faculté de Médecine

verifiedFacts.claim: The university's current formations page identifies its Faculty of Medicine and describes training in health with a clinical, research, and public-service orientation.
The university's guidance page lists Docteur en Médecine Humaine among Faculty of Medicine programmes.
For the academic year stated on its admissions page, entry to PACES at the Faculty of Medicine is by dossier selection for holders of the C, D, or S baccalaureate series.

The national higher-education ministry's 2021 authorized-institutions list records the Faculty of Medicine at Université d'Antananarivo and lists Médecine Humaine under health-science licence and state doctor of medicine provision.

holdReasons: No current Faculty of Medicine tuition or mandatory-fee schedule was located on an official source.
The selected official admissions page does not establish an active application window or a complete current document checklist.
Clinical-placement and student-support arrangements need current, provider-specific confirmation before publication.
nextAction: Obtain the current Faculty of Medicine prospectus or fee decision and current PACES calendar, then verify teaching language, clinical placements, and student support directly with the faculty.
